description: Committed rules-only reference for the CI eval gate (issue #63). pnpm eval:gate reruns diagnosisFindings with Grok skipped and compares these four rates to that run. They are the Baseline column of the pnpm eval scoreboard (issue #57). Latency, tokens, cost, and the Grok column stay out of the comparison. pnpm eval leaves this file in place. pnpm eval:gate -- --write replaces the counts and leaves this description and threshold.max_rate_drop in place.

threshold.note: Absolute rate difference allowed between this file and a fresh offline rules run. Numerator 0 means hits and total must match. A positive threshold fails only when the absolute difference is greater than this fraction; an equal difference passes. Lower a hits value and rerun pnpm eval:gate to see a red result. pnpm eval:gate -- --simulate-drop category_accuracy drops one fresh hit without editing this file.
